definition: to take part in physical exercise
description: A beach volleyball game at sunrise. A young woman in a black sports top and shorts dives low across the sand with her arms stretched out together and hits a blue and yellow volleyball high into the air, sand flying up behind her. She lands on her front, gets up on her knees and cheers with her fists raised. A volleyball net stands beside her, and friends at the edge of the court cheer and clap. Seagulls fly low over the beach and a jogger runs along the water's edge in the golden light.

en.question: What is the woman in front doing?

es.answer: Está haciendo deporte en la playa.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer de delante?

fr.answer: Elle fait du sport sur la plage.
phrases: faire du jogging le long de l'eau
fr.question: Que fait la femme au premier plan ?
